note: Bindings taken out of the addon API on purpose after their newest verify row became a partial or disagree. Keys are "<func|global>:<name>". mode deprecated keeps the binding exporting for one release, marked deprecated in the headers and in bindings.json; mode dropped stops exporting it and lists it in the "dropped" array of every bindings set. A binding is dropped without a deprecation release only when it crashes or corrupts state (harm: "crash" or "corrupts state"). since is the release the mode ships in, covers the V-id of the newest verify row (any newer row ends the entry), reason what is wrong with it, replacement an optional binding to use instead, and deprecated, on a dropped entry, the release that deprecated it. An entry for a renamed binding (binding.py rename) is keyed by its old name, covers the newest of the verify rows retired with the rename and names the new record as replacement; deprecated then exports the old name as an alias of the replacement. Only the repository owner approves a change to this file, and the release notes of each release list every entry whose since is that release.

func:Ne_Property_SetS64IfChanged.reason: renamed: every caller sets a UIDBRef weak object reference through it and the compare is object identity, not a numeric S64 compare

func:Ne_Std_ThrowException.reason: renamed: it is std::_Throw_bad_optional_access, which only raises std::bad_optional_access and ends the process in a fast fail
